api.entry: Publication::new() -> (Publication, Cancellation); Publication::publish(self, Request, checkpoint) -> Report<E>
api.input: Immutable borrowed byte slice, absolute parent Path, single OsStr leaf, bounded Limits. No source-file access and no input validation/worker evidence.
callbacks: Verifying before sync and every read, including EOF probe
BeforeCommit after byte/metadata checks and procfs setup
api.output: Report { outcome, usage, cleanup }. Outcome::Committed requires private FileCommitReceipt obtained only after linkat returns zero. No caller bool, public receipt constructor, Default, or Deserialize.
api.receipt: Parent and file device/inode plus length. Caller retains requested leaf separately. Identities are observations, not permanent identities after inode reuse. No bytes/hash or archive validity claim.

limits.memory: Borrow input without copying; fixed 64KiB scratch, bounded path allocations (parent<=4095 bytes, leaf<=255), at most 4 File handles. Does not bound caller's existing allocations, callbacks, allocator internals or filesystem/kernel memory.
limits.accounting: Reserve full requested read/write length and one attempt before each syscall; never refund on short/zero/error/EOF. Actual transferred bytes separately counted. EOF probe reserves 1 byte. open/metadata/sync/link counters are adapter attempts; metadata is std File::metadata. lseek and close excluded from IO byte/call budgets; close attempts/failures in Cleanup.
limits.termination: Cooperative elapsed-time check at checkpoints before commit. No hard deadline for callback, blocking syscall, sync or close. Postcommit sync/close are not interrupted by cancellation or elapsed limit. Per invocation usage; upper job layer must aggregate retries.

linux.parent: Reject nonabsolute, empty/repeated/trailing components, dot/dotdot, NUL, oversized paths. Root '/' is lexical-valid but must pass owner/mode and filesystem checks. openat2 O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOCTTY and RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS; no fallback.
linux.trust: fstat directory, effective UID owner, no group/other write bits. Only an exclusively managed destination directory with trusted same-UID actors is in scope. This is not an ACL, LSM, namespace, root or same-user adversary sandbox. No permission/security setting changes. Ancestors may move; no persistent pathname guarantee.
linux.filesystem: fstatfs magic 0xef53 (ext family, not proof specifically ext4) or 0x58465342 (XFS) only. Unknown/network/overlay/tmpfs rejected before temp creation. Actual O_TMPFILE support still required. Source-only: no mounted filesystem support verified.
linux.temporary: openat(held_parent, '.', O_TMPFILE|O_RDWR|O_CLOEXEC, 0600), without O_EXCL. fstat regular, nlink=0, euid owner, same st_dev. No named staging file.
linux.verification: Bounded raw write with positive short-write accumulation; zero write is WriteZero. fsync_file before lseek and exact chunk readback/EOF check. Native errors including EINTR preserved without raw IO retries. Final fstat checks same identity, regular type, nlink=0 and length. Readback is not archive validation, security isolation or protection from privileged/same-UID fd manipulation.
linux.procfs: openat2('/proc', O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY|O_CLOEXEC, RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS); fstatfs PROC_SUPER_MAGIC. Open numeric getpid()/fd relative to held proc root using BENEATH|NO_SYMLINKS|NO_XDEV. Keep all fds owned. Actual link source is numeric temp fd relative to proc fd directory with AT_SYMLINK_FOLLOW. Require trusted procfs for this PID namespace. No alternate /proc mount or launcher.
linux.commit: linkat(held_proc_fd_directory, numeric_temp_fd, held_parent, leaf, AT_SYMLINK_FOLLOW) exactly once after CAS. Existing leaf of any kind, including symlink/directory, is EEXIST; never truncate, overwrite, merge, rename or delete. No fallback on EXDEV, ENOSYS, unsupported FS/procfs or other error.
linux.namespace: Success belongs to held parent object and leaf at link return, not to the original parent pathname. Parent rename/replacement may cause commit into moved original directory; unlinked parent may fail. No postcheck can prove the original pathname persists; no later namespace stability claim.

cancellation.state: Per-publication private Arc<AtomicU8>: Pending -> Cancelled by request CAS, or Pending -> Committing by commit CAS, then Finished at Publication drop. SeqCst defines a total decision order.
cancellation.before: A cancellation CAS winning before begin_commit prevents linkat. Stop::Cancelled also stops before link. Callback(E) is returned unchanged, including when callback also requests cancellation. Native IO failures are returned before a later checkpoint and are not overwritten by cancellation.
cancellation.after: Committing wins: requests return TooLate until publication drops; link syscall result preserved, no callbacks after CAS. Success cannot become cancelled and no unlink rollback exists. A late request after returned report is Finished.
cancellation.abandon: Dropping unused Publication marks Finished without completion proof. Panic before commit unwinds RAII but returns no report; panic/abort and forced process death are not verified cleanup. Callback is trusted application code and may block or panic.

outcomes.NotCommitted: All pre-link failures, including unsupported platform/filesystem, cancellation, original callback or IO error, and linkat EEXIST. Preserves errno without flattening to archive failure. This is an operation observation, not assertion that no other actor changed destination.
outcomes.CommitUncertain: Any non-EEXIST linkat error is conservatively uncertain, including EXDEV/EINTR/ENOENT. Original io::Error retained, no receipt minted, no automatic retry/unlink. This deliberately overclassifies some definite failures pending later syscall-specific review.
outcomes.Committed: linkat returned zero. Private file-layer receipt exists even if parent fsync or close fails. Not OS worker, archive validation or product Published success.
outcomes.durability: File fsync failure is precommit failure. After link success, parent fsync success is FileAndParentSynced, otherwise ParentSyncFailed(original error). Two successful fsync returns are reported, not a guarantee against faulty storage or arbitrary crash recovery.
outcomes.cleanup: All acquired fds are explicitly close'd once on every normal return. Order temporary, proc fd directory, proc root, parent. Fixed four-slot failures retain resource and original errno separately. Never retry close (including EINTR), never unlink any name. Unlinked O_TMPFILE normally ceases to exist after last reference, but successful close is not physical deletion proof; close failure is not reported as confirmed cleanup. Panic path uses File RAII with unobserved close errors.

diagnostics: No stored full path, file content or raw byte Debug on Request/receipt/Report. Callback E and io::Error may carry caller-controlled data; consumers must redact rather than log raw Debug. No external transmission.
